title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Sticks to GDP-led recovery gains above 0.5700; bearish bias intact
summary: The NZD/USD pair gains some positive traction during the Asian session on Thursday in reaction to New Zealand's better-than-expected GDP print, snapping a three-day losing streak to its lowest level since July 9, touched the previous day.

title: Japan’s Katayama says expect BoJ to conduct appropriate monetary policy to achieve 2% price target
summary: Japanese Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama said on Thursday that official will review budget requests, control debt issuance at a level that can gain market credibility. Katayama also expect the Bank of Japan (BoJ) to steer policy properly to achieve stable, sustainable 2% inflation.

title: Gold stalls recovery from six-week low as USD preserves post-Fed gains amid Iran risks
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts some buyers during the Asian session on Thursday, though it struggles to find acceptance above the $4,300 mark and remains close to a near six-week low, touched the previous day.
